Professional Summary

Senior Site Reliability Engineer & Solutions Engineer with 10+ years of progressive IT experience specializing in Observability, Monitoring, and DevOps/SRE practices. Proven expertise in managing enterprise-scale observability platforms (Splunk Cloud/ITSI, Datadog, New Relic, Oracle O&M), implementing SLOs/SLIs and error budgets, and automating reliability workflows using Python and Terraform. Skilled in CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, OCI), and modern SRE methodologies. Adept at driving technical solutions, mentoring teams, and ensuring high system availability and cost-efficient monitoring strategies.
